# Cyber Kings: generic world-struggle effects. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/struggles/gen_world_struggles.py.

# The Concord's leading power takes a de jure hegemony (h_venus, h_mercury, h_moon). root = leader
ck_struggle_take_hegemony_effect = {
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	title:$HEG$ = {
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = root
			change = scope:change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
	hidden_effect = { set_primary_title_to = title:$HEG$ }
	add_prestige = 1000
}

##### Terra (ck_struggle_terra) #####
# Global variables: ck_terra_contender, ck_terra_collapse_years, ck_terra_last_ending (flag:dominion/balance/concord/collapse),
# ck_terra_ender, ck_terra_had_great_power, ck_terra_struggle_cooldown (50 years after any ending)

# yearly_global_pulse: start (35% rule), Collapse watch
ck_terra_struggle_yearly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = struggle:ck_struggle_terra }
		# Collapse only counts once some realm has reached the great-power share in this struggle
		# (Luna starts fragmented at 7050 and must not collapse before anyone has risen).
		if = {
			limit = { any_independent_ruler = { ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth SHARE = ck_terra_great_power_counties } } }
			set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_had_great_power value = yes }
			set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_collapse_years value = 0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = ck_terra_had_great_power }
			change_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_collapse_years add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { global_var:ck_terra_collapse_years >= ck_struggle_collapse_years_needed }
				set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_last_ending value = flag:collapse }
				struggle:ck_struggle_terra = { end_struggle = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = ck_terra_struggle_cooldown }
			any_independent_ruler = { ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth SHARE = ck_terra_start_counties } }
		}
		random_independent_ruler = {
			limit = { ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth SHARE = ck_terra_start_counties } }
			set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_contender value = this }
			set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_collapse_years value = 0 }
			start_struggle = {
				struggle_type = ck_struggle_terra
				start_phase = ck_terra_phase_opportunity
			}
		}
	}
}

# root = struggle
ck_terra_struggle_on_start_effect = {
	every_player = {
		trigger_event = ck_struggles.0001
	}
}

# root = struggle
ck_terra_struggle_on_end_effect = {
	set_global_variable = {
		name = ck_terra_struggle_cooldown
		value = yes
		days = ck_struggle_cooldown_days
	}
	remove_global_variable = ck_terra_collapse_years
	remove_global_variable = ck_terra_contender
	remove_global_variable = ck_terra_had_great_power
	every_player = {
		trigger_event = ck_struggles.0010
	}
}

##### Ending effects (root = the ender) #####

ck_terra_ending_dominion_effect = {
	add_prestige = 1500
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_terra_dominion_modifier years = 100 }
	custom_tooltip = ck_terra_ending_dominion_effect_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_independent_ruler = {
			limit = {
				this != root
				ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth }
			}
			add_opinion = { target = root modifier = ck_struggle_dominion_opinion }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_last_ending value = flag:dominion }
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_ender value = root }
		struggle:ck_struggle_terra ?= { end_struggle = ck_terra_ending_dominion_decision }
	}
}

ck_terra_ending_balance_effect = {
	add_prestige = 1000
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_terra_balance_architect_modifier years = 100 }
	custom_tooltip = ck_terra_ending_balance_effect_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_independent_ruler = {
			limit = {
				ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth }
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			}
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_terra_balance_modifier years = 100 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_last_ending value = flag:balance }
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_ender value = root }
		struggle:ck_struggle_terra ?= { end_struggle = ck_terra_ending_balance_decision }
	}
}

# The leading power takes the hegemony by agreement (if it does not hold it already)
# and invites every other independent ruler of the world into it (ck_struggles.0020).
ck_terra_ending_concord_effect = {
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_terra_concord_modifier years = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_title = title:h_ck_terra } }
		ck_hegemony_found_effect = { HEG = h_ck_terra BLOC = ckworld_earth FOUNDER_EVENT = ck_hegemony.0001 WORLD_EVENT = ck_hegemony.0011 }
	}
	else = {
		add_prestige = 1000
	}
	custom_tooltip = ck_terra_ending_concord_effect_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		save_scope_as = ck_struggle_concord_leader
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_last_ending value = flag:concord }
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_terra_ender value = root }
		every_independent_ruler = {
			limit = {
				this != root
				ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = ckworld_earth }
			}
			trigger_event = { id = ck_struggles.0020 days = { 1 30 } }
		}
		struggle:ck_struggle_terra ?= { end_struggle = ck_terra_ending_concord_decision }
	}
}

##### The Jovian Schism (ck_struggle_jovian, religious) #####
# Global variables: ck_jovian_last_ending (flag:triumph/settlement/concordat/healed), ck_jovian_ender, ck_jovian_struggle_cooldown

# yearly_global_pulse: automatic end when one faith holds 80%; restart while no faith holds 60% (after the cooldown)
ck_jovian_struggle_yearly_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = struggle:ck_struggle_jovian }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:zensunni SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:gnostic_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:ancestor_worship_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:shia SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:kushitism_pagan SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:eternal_mechanism SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:theravada_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:reaverism_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:rabbinic_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_healed_counties } } }
			set_global_variable = { name = ck_jovian_last_ending value = flag:healed }
			struggle:ck_struggle_jovian = { end_struggle = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = ck_jovian_struggle_cooldown }
			NOT = { OR = { ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:zensunni SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:gnostic_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:ancestor_worship_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:shia SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:kushitism_pagan SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:eternal_mechanism SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:theravada_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:reaverism_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean FAITH = faith:rabbinic_faith SHARE = ck_jovian_restart_max_counties } } }
		}
		start_struggle = {
			struggle_type = ck_struggle_jovian
			start_phase = ck_jovian_phase_opportunity
		}
	}
}

ck_jovian_struggle_on_start_effect = {
	every_player = { trigger_event = ck_struggles.0401 }
}

ck_jovian_struggle_on_end_effect = {
	set_global_variable = {
		name = ck_jovian_struggle_cooldown
		value = yes
		days = ck_struggle_cooldown_days
	}
	every_player = { trigger_event = ck_struggles.0410 }
}

# Triumph of the Faith (vanilla Hostility ending). root = ender
ck_jovian_ending_triumph_effect = {
	add_piety = 1500
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_jovian_triumph_modifier years = 100 }
	faith = {
		change_fervor = {
			value = major_fervor_value
			desc = ck_jovian_triumph_fervor
		}
	}
	custom_tooltip = ck_jovian_ending_triumph_effect_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_independent_ruler = {
			limit = {
				this != root
				ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean }
				NOT = { faith = root.faith }
			}
			add_opinion = { target = root modifier = ck_struggle_dominion_opinion }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_jovian_last_ending value = flag:triumph }
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_jovian_ender value = root }
		struggle:ck_struggle_jovian ?= { end_struggle = ck_jovian_ending_triumph_decision }
	}
}

# Jovian Settlement (vanilla Compromise ending)
ck_jovian_ending_settlement_effect = {
	add_piety = 1000
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_jovian_settlement_architect_modifier years = 100 }
	custom_tooltip = ck_jovian_ending_settlement_effect_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_independent_ruler = {
			limit = {
				ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean }
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			}
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_jovian_settlement_modifier years = 100 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_jovian_last_ending value = flag:settlement }
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_jovian_ender value = root }
		struggle:ck_struggle_jovian ?= { end_struggle = ck_jovian_ending_settlement_decision }
	}
}

# Jovian Concordat (vanilla Conciliation ending): a council of the faiths; no title changes hands
ck_jovian_ending_concordat_effect = {
	add_piety = 1500
	add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_jovian_concordat_leader_modifier years = 100 }
	custom_tooltip = ck_jovian_ending_concordat_effect_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_independent_ruler = {
			limit = {
				ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = ckbloc_galilean }
			}
			add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_jovian_concordat_modifier years = 100 }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_jovian_last_ending value = flag:concordat }
		set_global_variable = { name = ck_jovian_ender value = root }
		struggle:ck_struggle_jovian ?= { end_struggle = ck_jovian_ending_concordat_decision }
	}
}
